rca of the issue: Razorpay live merchant account (rzp_live_StwxFqd60PF0VM) is not entitled to the QR Codes API. All requests to POST /v1/payments/qr_codes (even minimal valid payloads) return HTTP 500 with generic 'We are facing some trouble completing your request at the moment' — Razorpay's canonical error when a feature isn't activated for the account. Reproduction: `python -c "import razorpay,time,os; c=razorpay.Client(auth=(k,s)); c.qrcode.create({'type':'upi_qr','name':'x','usage':'single_use','fixed_amount':True,'payment_amount':10000,'close_by':int(time.time())+3600*3})"` → ServerError. Mitigation: enable QR Codes product in Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Configuration; or contact Razorpay support. Backend already handles this gracefully via UPI-intent fallback.
